## Overview

The Starling 2 Max is a quadrotor with a powerful onboard computer, a PX4 flight controller, and a set of cameras built for navigating without GPS using visual-inertial odometry. Its long flight time and 500 g payload capacity make it well suited to experiments that run an autonomy stack entirely onboard.
